symbols.name: has
symbols.doc: map membership: `m has k` -> Boolean (same as `m.has(k)`).

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.doc: sorted copy of a list: `sorted l` / `sorted l by <lambda>` (same as `l.sorted()` / `l.sorted_by(f)`).

symbols.name: reversed
symbols.doc: reversed copy of a list: `reversed l` (same as `l.reversed()`).

symbols.name: first
symbols.doc: first element of a list: `first of l` -> Optional<T> (same as `l.first`).

symbols.name: last
symbols.doc: last element of a list: `last of l` -> Optional<T> (same as `l.last`).

symbols.name: ai
symbols.doc: `ai { }` block: one custom AI group of targets + goals on a mob.

symbols.name: goals
symbols.doc: `goals: [ Chase priority 1, Wander ]` — attach reusable named goal types.

symbols.name: should_start
symbols.doc: `should_start { <Boolean> }` — goal lifecycle: whether the goal may begin this tick (default true).

symbols.name: on_start
symbols.doc: `on_start { }` — goal lifecycle: runs once when the goal begins.

symbols.name: should_end
symbols.doc: `should_end { <Boolean> }` — goal lifecycle: whether the goal is finished (default false).

symbols.name: on_end
symbols.doc: `on_end { }` — goal lifecycle: runs once when the goal ends.

symbols.name: path
symbols.doc: `path <mob> to <Entity|Location> [at speed <n>]` — start/continue an A* path (navigator.setPathTo).

symbols.name: pathing
symbols.doc: `stop pathing <mob>` — reset the navigator (clear the active path).

symbols.name: look
symbols.doc: `look at <Entity|Location>` — face a target without moving.

symbols.name: speed
symbols.doc: `path <mob> to <pt> at speed <n>` — path with a movement-speed modifier.

symbols.name: within
symbols.doc: `target closest Player within <n>` — range (in blocks) of a natural target selector.

symbols.name: priority
symbols.doc: `goal "..." priority N` / `goals: [ Chase priority 1 ]` — lower N = higher priority.

symbols.name: reached
symbols.doc: `<mob> reached <Entity|Location>` -> Boolean — at/adjacent to the goal point.

symbols.name: closest
symbols.doc: `target closest Player|hostile|<MobType> within <n>` — a natural target selector.

symbols.name: hostile
symbols.doc: `target closest hostile within <n>` — the nearest hostile mob.

symbols.name: attacker
symbols.doc: `target last attacker within <n>` — the entity that last damaged this mob.

symbols.name: navigating
symbols.doc: `<mob>.navigating` -> Boolean — whether the mob has an active path.

symbols.name: backend
symbols.doc: `backend: files "dir" | sqlite "file" | mysql { … } | mongodb { … }` — where persistent values are stored.

symbols.name: flush
symbols.doc: `flush: every 30 seconds` — write-behind checkpoint interval. Under `mode: network` this is ONLY a crash checkpoint, never the handoff path.

symbols.name: mode
symbols.doc: `mode: standalone | network` — storage topology. Declarations and game code are byte-identical in both modes.

symbols.name: on_handoff_failure
symbols.doc: `on_handoff_failure: kick "<message>"` — what to do when a session lease can't be acquired (backend down / lease stuck). Default: kick. Never serves default or duplicated data.

symbols.name: coordinator
symbols.doc: `coordinator: redis "redis://host"` — OPTIONAL lease store + pub-sub channel. Defaults to a lease table in `backend`.

symbols.name: standalone
symbols.doc: `mode: standalone` (default) — single server; today's write-behind behavior, unchanged.

symbols.name: network
symbols.doc: `mode: network` — multi-server behind a proxy: session ownership + leases for `for Player` values, replicated globals. REQUIRES a shared backend (mysql/mongodb).

symbols.name: kick
symbols.doc: `on_handoff_failure: kick "<message>"` — disconnect the player rather than serve stale or default data.

symbols.name: redis
symbols.doc: `coordinator: redis "redis://host:6379"` — Redis lease store and broadcast channel.

symbols.name: files
symbols.doc: `backend: files "data/game"` — one file per value. Cannot coordinate servers (`mode: network` is a compile error).

symbols.name: sqlite
symbols.doc: `backend: sqlite "data/game.db"` — local database. Cannot coordinate servers (`mode: network` is a compile error).

symbols.name: mysql
symbols.doc: `backend: mysql { host: "…", port: 3306, database: "…", user: "…", password: env("…") }` — shared backend, usable with `mode: network`.

symbols.name: mongodb
symbols.doc: `backend: mongodb { host: "…", port: 27017, database: "…", user: "…", password: env("…") }` — shared backend, usable with `mode: network`.

symbols.name: on_change
symbols.doc: `on_change { }` on a persistent declaration — fires on EVERY server (including the writer) when the value really changes. Bound: `old`, `new`, `caused_here`, plus `player`/`key` for a keyed decl. Not fired on load/restore.

symbols.name: on_entry_change
symbols.doc: `on_entry_change { }` on a persistent Map/List — fires per ENTRY. Bound: `key`, `old: Optional<V>`, `new: Optional<V>`, `caused_here`. `old is none` = insert, `new is none` = remove.

symbols.name: old
symbols.doc: `old` — the value before the change (in a collection handler: `Optional<V>`, `none` when the entry was inserted).

symbols.name: new
symbols.doc: `new` — the value after the change (in a collection handler: `Optional<V>`, `none` when the entry was removed).

symbols.name: caused_here
symbols.doc: `caused_here: Boolean` — true on the server that made the write. `if caused_here` = local-only, `if not caused_here` = remote-only, no guard = react everywhere.

symbols.name: key
symbols.doc: `key` — the changed entry's key (`on_entry_change`), or the declaration key of a `for Integer`/`for String` decl.

symbols.name: player
symbols.doc: `player` — the declaration key of a `for Player` / `for OfflinePlayer` persistent value inside its change handler.

symbols.name: subtract
symbols.doc: `subtract <n> from <persistent>` — atomic decrement, safe across servers (unlike `set x to x - n`).

symbols.name: append
symbols.doc: `append <value> to <persistent list>` — atomic list append, safe across servers.

symbols.name: grant
symbols.doc: `grant <n> <persistent> to <player>` — atomic increment routed to the owning server; the only legal write to a player this server does not own.

symbols.name: @EventReceiver
symbols.doc: `@EventReceiver` struct-field modifier: marks the field as an event subject for a reactive block (§4).
